a5.rationale: The presence of dermoepidermal separation and a novel heterozygous missense variant in COL7A1, a gene associated with Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa, provides strong evidence for this diagnosis. Although Epidermolysis Bullosa Pruriginosa is supported by pruritic erythematous to violaceous lichenified papules and plaques and milia, the genetic findings and histopathologic examination of dermoepidermal separation more decisively support Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa.
